basic_info.description: Light and bright, Residence 10 at 350 San Jose boasts the largest outdoor space in the building.  Situated on quiet block of San Jose Avenue, this spacious home features apx. 1,121 sq.ft., spacious great room and island kitchen. The primary suite is fit for a resort with double vanities, luxurious walk-in shower and built-out closet. Second bedroom room has direct access to the second bathroom and built-out closet. Underfloor heating, fully integrated kitchen appliances, included washer, dryer, and designer-finishes throughout.
